decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (729LonRd-Gnd-01, 729LonRd-1st-01, Location Plan, Planning, Design & Access Statement received 14/02/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - In the event that a D1 (non-residential medical) use is implemented, the premises shall be used for a non-residential medical use only and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1, including as a substance misuse clinic or a needle exchange clinic, of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
description: Change of use of the property from medical centre (D1 non-residential use) to a flexible use comprising B1 (office) and D1 (non-residential medical)
